local _lII11_l1 = string.char
local _II__Ill_ = unpack or table.unpack
local _l_l1_l11 = bit32.bxor
local I_l1IIl1_ = select

local function _I__11III(proto, env, upvalues)
    local code = proto.code
    local consts = proto.consts
    local protos = proto.protos
    local num_params = proto.params
    local is_vararg = proto.vararg == 1
    local max_stack = proto.max_stack

    local decoded_consts = {}
    for i = 1, #consts do
        local c = consts[i]
        local c_type = c[1]
        if c_type == 0 then
            decoded_consts[i] = nil
        elseif c_type == 1 then
            decoded_consts[i] = (c[2] == 1)
        elseif c_type == 2 then
            decoded_consts[i] = c[2]
        elseif c_type == 3 then
            local bytes_arr = c[2]
            local str_chars = {}
            for j = 1, #bytes_arr do
                str_chars[j] = _lII11_l1(_l_l1_l11(bytes_arr[j], l_l_ll111.const_key))
            end
            decoded_consts[i] = table.concat(str_chars)
        end
    end

        local stack = {}
        local open_upvals = {}
        local top_stack = 0
        local pc = 1
        local num_code = #code

        local args_count = I_l1IIl1_("#", ...)
        local varargs = {}
        if args_count > 0 then
            for i = 1, num_params do
                stack[i - 1] = I_l1IIl1_(i, ...)
            end
            if is_vararg and args_count > num_params then
                for i = num_params + 1, args_count do
                    varargs[i - num_params] = I_l1IIl1_(i, ...)
                end
            end
        end        local function RK(val)
            if val >= 1000000 then
                return decoded_consts[val - 1000000 + 1]
            end
            return stack[val]
        end

        local function set_reg(r, v)
            stack[r] = v
            local ou = open_upvals[r]
            if ou then
                ou[1] = v
            end
        end

        while pc <= num_code do

            local op = inst[1]
            local a = _l_l1_l11(inst[2], l_l_ll111.mask_a)
            local b = _l_l1_l11(inst[3], l_l_ll111.mask_b)
            local c = _l_l1_l11(inst[4], l_l_ll111.mask_c)

            local bx = _l_l1_l11(inst[6], l_l_ll111.mask_bx)

            elseif op == 5 then
                set_reg(a, decoded_consts[bx + 1])

                    end

                    return _II__Ill_(ret_vals, 1, num_rets)
                end

            elseif op == 22 then
                set_reg(a, stack[a] - stack[a + 2])
                pc = pc + sbx

            elseif op == 3 then

                local val = stack[a] + step

                if (step > 0 and val <= limit) or (step <= 0 and val >= limit) then

                end

                end

                local offset = (c - 1) * 50
                for i = 1, b do tab[offset + i] = stack[a + i] end

            elseif op == 19 then

                local child_upvals = {}
                for i = 1, #(child_proto.upvals) do
                    local u = child_proto.upvals[i]
                    if u[1] == 1 then
                        local reg = u[2]
                        if not open_upvals[reg] then
                            open_upvals[reg] = { stack[reg] }
                        end
                        child_upvals[i] = open_upvals[reg]
                    else
                        child_upvals[i] = upvalues[u[2] + 1]
                    end
                end
                set_reg(a, _I__11III(child_proto, env, child_upvals))

            elseif op == 37 then
                local num_va = #varargs
                if b == 0 then
                    for i = 1, num_va do set_reg(a + i - 1, varargs[i]) end
                    top_stack = a + num_va - 1
                else
                    for i = 1, b - 1 do set_reg(a + i - 1, varargs[i]) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
